_comment:
'If this is defended by an action card, this has -2{p}.' Generic Action - Attack. Release note: 'If this is defended by two or more action cards, it still only gets -2{p} in total' -- i.e. ONE conditional continuous penalty, capped once, not a per-defender subtraction.

DELIBERATE STUB, mirroring .drafts/freewheeling_renegades_red.json (identical printed text across printings): the ENTIRE card is this one clause and NO existing condition gates it correctly. Every route silently does the wrong thing - all re-verified in the handlers this session:

(a) The natural shape is WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER + conditions + MODIFY_ATTACK add -2 (spelling proven by wtr/barraging_brawnhide_red.json; the release-note cap falls out of the stage-8 window - effect_types.py:4134-4144 applies WHILE_STATIC mods transiently once per recalculation and never accumulates). That needs a condition testing whether ANY declared defender is an ACTION-type card. None exists:

  - DEFENDING_CARD_IS {'card_type': 'Action'} has the right MATCHER (its want_types compare the target's types+subtypes, condition_types.py:579-609) but the wrong TIMING: outside the defence-recalc pass combat.defense_recalc_card is None and the filtered form returns False in EVERY state (condition_types.py:591-602). defense_recalc_card is set only inside _recalculate_total_defense around the RECALC_DEFENSE dispatches; RECALC_ATTACK_POWER never sets it. Authored this way the -2 would NEVER fire while looking implemented.

  - DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT counts defenders but filters only on equipment / power_gte_attack (condition_types.py:629-670) - it cannot say 'action card'. Unfiltered gte 1 would apply -2 whenever defended by ANY card, over-applying in every game with an equipment block (ubiquitous) - exactly the silent-wrongness class to avoid.

  - TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND is no fallback: the defend event dispatches to the DEFENDING card, never to the attack card, so this attack action card would never receive it.

(b) A one-shot ON_ATTACK/ON_HIT trigger is wrong in kind: the penalty must appear and disappear with the defender set across recalculations (defenders are declared after the first recalc), not fire once at declaration when defending_cards is still empty.

SMALLEST GENERIC FIX that makes this authorable: a card_type/subtypes filter key on DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT (the same gap the hot_streak, familiar_story_red and cintari_saber triage notes name). The clause would then be WHILE_STATIC + [{'type':'DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT','amount':1,'comparison':'gte','card_type':'Action'}] + MODIFY_ATTACK add -2.
